items.content: AFP publication · PGD submitted Research with Prof. Shoham Sabach Origin / Chronohaze Feier Lyu Fay OPTIMIZATION · FORMAL VERIFICATION · MACHINE-CHECKED MATHEMATICS In the haze of time, I look for structure in complexity. Proof asks what can be trusted; music and image ask what deserves to be remembered. This site gathers the work that continues between them. items.title: Selected Work
items.excerpt: 精选形式化项目、优化研究笔记、合作研究方向，以及作为侧项目展示的创意计算原型。
items.excerpt_en: Selected formalizations, optimization research notes, collaborative research directions, and a supporting creative-computation prototype.
items.content: 代表性工作 研究陈述 技术笔记 代表性工作 Feier Lyu （Fay Lyu） 主序列只保留已发表、已提交与进行中的代表性工作；探索性推导与创意计算原型分别归档。 Selected Work Feier Lyu (Fay Lyu) The primary sequence contains published, submitted, and ongoing representative work. Exploratory derivations and creative-computation prototypes are archived separately. 代表性工作 代表性工作 PUB 已发表 · 形式化验证 Greedy Algorithms for Cardinality-Constrained Submodular Maximization 状态： 2026 年 5 月 26 日正式发表于 AFP。AFP 条目覆盖经典贪心算法与经验证的有状态惰性贪心变体；当前仓库另含发表后的 StochasticGreedy 扩展，包括采样模型、近似证明与预言机调用复杂度界。 问题： 形式化基数约束单调子模最大化中经典贪心算法的 1−1/e 近似保证。 贡献： 在 Wenda Li 老师指导下，本人负责完整的 Isabelle/HOL 形式化开发，覆盖经典贪心算法与经验证的有状态惰性贪心变体。 链接： AFP 证明文档 GitHub DOI SUB 已提交 · 形式化验证 First-Order Methods for Smooth Convex Optimization in Isabelle/HOL 状态： 2026 年 7 月 2 日提交至 Archive of Formal Proofs，目前等待审核。 问题： 将投影梯度下降及其一阶收敛理论组织成可复用的 Isabelle/HOL 基础设施。 贡献： 独立形式化项目；本人负责完整的 Isabelle/HOL 形式化开发，覆盖投影几何、投影梯度映射、凸收敛与强凸线性收敛率。 链接： 项目页面 GitHub JOINT 合作研究 · 网络定位 Negative-Curvature Certificates for Network Localization 状态： 与 Prof. Shoham Sabach 开展中的合作研究。 问题： 对网络定位中的非最优驻点，哪些图结构与几何条件能给出负曲率证书和可计算的局部逃逸方向？ 贡献： 我目前的工作是构造并检查投影边预算条件、基于能量的逃逸方向，以及用于检验负曲率的 Hessian 分解。 链接： 研究记录 推导过程（一） 推导过程（二） 探索性归档 Exploratory Archive NOTE 探索性笔记 · 极小极大优化 TTGDA and Second-Order Tracking 状态： 探索性推导；保留供定向阅读，不列入代表性工作主序列。 问题： 双时间尺度值函数跟踪能否通过 Schur 补 Hessian 支持二阶鞍点逃逸？ PDF 技术笔记 创意计算 实验性原型 SIDE 创意计算 / 实验性原型 Metalcore Piano Lab 状态： 侧项目 · 实验性原型 · 开发中；不作为研究成果列出。 问题： 如何把连续的音频与节奏流转换为保留节拍、段落与可玩性约束的离散谱面？ 贡献： 设计并实现浏览器原生的分析与谱面生成原型，包括起音检测、节拍网格、段落对齐与可玩性约束。 链接： GitHub 项目笔记 SELECTED WORK Selected Work PUB PUBLISHED · FORMAL VERIFICATION Greedy Algorithms for Cardinality-Constrained Submodular Maximization Status: Published in the Archive of Formal Proofs on May 26, 2026. The AFP entry covers classical greedy and a verified stateful lazy-greedy variant; the current repository additionally contains a post-publication stochastic-greedy extension with the sampling model, approximation proof, and oracle-cost bounds. Problem: Formalize the classical 1−1/e approximation guarantee for cardinality-constrained monotone submodular maximization. Contribution: I was responsible for the full Isabelle/HOL development under the supervision of Wenda Li, covering classical greedy and a verified stateful lazy-greedy variant. Links: AFP Proof document GitHub DOI SUB SUBMITTED · FORMAL VERIFICATION First-Order Methods for Smooth Convex Optimization in Isabelle/HOL Status: Submitted to the Archive of Formal Proofs on July 2, 2026; awaiting review. Problem: Formalize projected gradient descent and its first-order convergence theory as reusable Isabelle/HOL infrastructure. Contribution: Independent formalization project. I was responsible for the full Isabelle/HOL development, covering projection geometry, projected-gradient mapping, convex convergence, and a strongly convex linear rate. Links: Project page GitHub JOINT ONGOING COLLABORATION · NETWORK LOCALIZATION Negative-Curvature Certificates for Network Localization Status: Ongoing collaboration with Prof. Shoham Sabach. Problem: For non-optimal stationary points in network localization, which graph and geometric conditions yield a negative-curvature certificate and a computable local escape direction? Contribution: My current work develops and checks projected-edge budget conditions, energy-based escape constructions, and the Hessian decomposition used to test negative curvature. Links: Research record Earlier derivation I Earlier derivation II EXPLORATORY ARCHIVE Exploratory Archive NOTE EXPLORATORY NOTE · MINIMAX OPTIMIZATION TTGDA and Second-Order Tracking Status: Exploratory derivation retained for directed reading; not part of the primary Selected Work sequence. Problem: Can two-timescale value-function tracking support second-order saddle escaping through the Schur-complement Hessian? PDF note CREATIVE COMPUTATION Experimental Prototype SIDE CREATIVE COMPUTATION / EXPERIMENTAL PROTOTYPE Metalcore Piano Lab Status: Side project · experimental prototype · work in progress; not presented as a research output. Problem: How can continuous audio / rhythm streams become discrete charts while preserving beat, section, and playability constraints? Contribution: Designed and implemented the browser-native analysis and chart-generation prototype, including onset detection, beat grids, section alignment, and playability constraints.
